description: This Java class 'PlaceholderSubstitution' implements a function to perform placeholder substitution on objects implementing 'WithDittoHeaders' using specified strategies and algorithms. It provides methods to create instances with default or extended replacement definitions and applies substitution strategies asynchronously.

classes.name: PlaceholderSubstitution
classes.description: A final class implementing a substitution function for headers, providing methods to instantiate with default or extended definitions and applying substitution strategies asynchronously.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance with default replacement definitions.

methods.name: newExtendedInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance with default replacement definitions extended with additional definitions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the substitution strategy asynchronously to the given 'WithDittoHeaders' object.

methods.name: createDefaultReplacementDefinitions
methods.description: Creates an unmodifiable map of default replacement definitions.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Constructs a new 'PlaceholderSubstitution' with specified replacement definitions.
